name: Checkbox
description: Mortar foundation checkbox, using central semantic tokens.

props.label: ReactNode
props.description: ReactNode (the checkbox's hint, linked by aria-describedby)
props.error: string (announced when it appears; marks the checkbox aria-invalid and links the message by aria-describedby)
props.id: string (defaults to a generated id when there is a description or error)
props.required: boolean (native; adds a decorative marker to the label)

contract.usage: Import { Checkbox } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
